front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《11》

en: A dream that lost its way
On the axis line of the years
Wandering
Winter night
Copying out lines of poetry
The ink is spent, the heart lies beyond the brush
Unable to stop the sun from rising and the moon from setting
Unable to stop the wind from blowing and the clouds from drifting
I am waterweed drifting with the current
The setting sun slants down, the stone street vast and dim
In the wind someone stands alone
Listening to the trembling of the zither's voice

points.zh:
在風中獨立的人都已風化
在風中，在落日的風中
我思索 : 一個詩人如何證實自己
依靠著風
他如何向大風歌唱 ?
除了…愛啊，通過愛
通過他的土地，他的民族
他的年代
他如何在風中把握自己
一如琴弦在音樂中顫慄，發聲
與歌唱.....
--楊澤《 在風中 》
points.en:
Those who stand alone in the wind have all weathered away
In the wind, in the wind of the setting sun
I ponder: how does a poet prove himself?
Relying on the wind
How does he sing to the great wind?
Except... through love, ah, through love
Through his land, his people
His era
How does he hold onto himself in the wind
Just as a zither string trembles and sounds within music
And sings.....
-- Yang Ze, "In the Wind" (在風中)

en: The years, tangled and many
Have I ever missed such a shore?
Hazy as mist, crystalline as frost
There is such an empty, silent mountain forest
There is such a mood of quiet contemplation
A day in the Tang dynasty

points.zh:
空山不見人，但聞人語響。
返景入幽林，復照青苔上。
--唐。王維《 鹿柴 》
points.en:
On the empty mountain, no one is seen, only the sound of voices is heard.
Returning light enters the deep forest, shining again upon the green moss.
-- Tang dynasty. Wang Wei, 'Deer Enclosure'

en: A shower of rain
Covering the twilight of distant mountains
Is it time to go home?
Once, the grass was green for no reason at all
The sky is blue for no reason at all
And you, simple and beautiful
Autumn wind rolls up fallen leaves
In some corner of life
Did I ever long for the snow to fall thick and fast?

zh: 說說羅莽湖畔的雲霧吧 !
en: Next time I meet you
in that small town by the lake?
Let's talk about the clouds and mist by Loch Lomond!

points.zh:
《羅莽湖畔》  ( Loch Lomond  ) ，《安娜羅荔》 (  Annie Laurie  ) 和《山谷中的燈火》  (  When the Lamp Lighting Time in the Valley )) 都是傳唱已久的蘇格蘭民謠，每首歌都有人物故事的背景。蘇格蘭高地峻嶺起伏，山谷翠綠綿延，湖水掩映，雨霧煙嵐時起時散，清凄的民謠傳說迴蕩其中，自有一縷動人心弦的迷濛詩意。 中學時期的歌本《世界藝術名歌 101 》就收錄了這三首歌。
《 羅莽湖畔 》歌詞
「  出城郊，風光好，望遠坡，真美麗，香塵日照裡，羅莽湖畔，憶當初，雙情侶，終朝攜手共遊戲，在那美麗美麗的羅莽湖畔。你要越高山，我要屨平夷，到鄉關行路難，你來何遲，哦，哦，雙情侶從今恐無相見期，在那美麗美麗的羅莽湖畔。」
從高中時代起，便很喜歡這首蘇格蘭民謠《羅莽湖畔》，一直只當是描述山嶺湖水以及情人離別的歌。自從對歌曲背景及塞爾特人的歷史有更多瞭解後，獨自啍唱或靜聽這首古老的情歌時，心中總浮起陣陣波濤， 在抒情之中，參雜著對遙遠國度那份悲愁的歷史情緒，也感染着塞爾特人堅忍卓絶的民族毅力。
points.en:
"Loch Lomond" (Loch Lomond), "Annie Laurie" (Annie Laurie), and "When the Lamps Are Lit in the Valley" (When the Lamp Lighting Time in the Valley) are all long-cherished Scottish folk songs, each carrying the background story of its characters. In the Scottish Highlands, rugged peaks rise and fall, green valleys stretch on and on, lakes reflect the scenery, and rain and mist rise and disperse by turns; clear, mournful folk legends echo throughout, giving rise to their own thread of moving, hazy poetry. The middle-school songbook "101 Famous Songs of World Art" included all three of these songs.
Lyrics of "Loch Lomond"
"Leaving the city outskirts, the scenery fine, gazing at the distant slopes, so beautiful, fragrant dust in the sunlight, by the shores of Loch Lomond, recalling the past, a pair of lovers, hand in hand all day at play, on that beautiful, beautiful shore of Loch Lomond. You will take the high road, I will take the low road, the way home is hard, why have you come so late, oh, oh, the pair of lovers may from now on never meet again, on that beautiful, beautiful shore of Loch Lomond."
Since my high school years, I have loved this Scottish folk song "Loch Lomond," always taking it simply as a description of mountains, lakes, and lovers parting. Since coming to understand more about the song's background and the history of the Celtic people, whenever I hum it alone or listen quietly to this ancient love song, waves always rise in my heart—amid its lyricism mixed with a sorrowful historical sentiment for that distant land, and also moved by the tenacious, unyielding perseverance of the Celtic people.

points.zh:
**
《羅莽湖畔》，這首傳唱久遠的蘇格蘭民謠，浸染着一段蘇格蘭慘烈的歷史。
1745年，以蘇格蘭高地 (Highlands) 氏族為主的Jacobite黨人，第二度大規模起義反抗倫敦朝廷。經過幾回征戰，起初蘇格蘭的軍隊一度還打到距倫敦只有一百三十多哩的Derby，京城倫敦為之震動。但Jacobites黨人於翌年1746年四月，在蘇格蘭Culloden的決定性一役中慘遭殲滅，歷時逾半世紀的Jacobite黨人反抗運動也因此畫下句點。
在這場戰役中，英軍把俘擄的蘇格蘭人，囚禁在鄰近蘇格蘭邊界的卡萊爾 (Carlisle)城堡。英格蘭人對待這些蘇格蘭戰俘沒有一定懲處的標準，而是任意挑選，有的處死，有的釋放。據說，蘇格蘭戰俘中有一人預感自己將被處決，寫了Loch Lomond這首歌，託給一位被釋放的牢友，帶回去給他住在羅莽湖畔的情人。這首哀思悲愴，悱惻幽怨的歌謠，就這樣飄盪在蘇格蘭山丘草原，在雲霧繚繞中，綿綿的傳唱至今。
《 安娜羅荔 》歌詞
「 美麗的麥威頓坡，坡上新露清淒，在那裡，安娜羅荔給我難忘的信誓，她說永不分離，我說永不相背，為著可愛的安娜羅荔，我的心至死不移。」
《 山谷中的燈火 》 歌詞
「  燈火在小屋中發著亮光，在窗中為著遠遊的我閃爍，我知道母親正在那兒祈禱，為著她渴見的孩子禱告，當燈火在山谷中照耀，在夢中我返家若倦鳥，看見那燈火在窗中閃耀，在我徘徊處向我招手。」
points.en:
**
「Loch Lomond」, this long-sung Scottish folk ballad, is steeped in a tragic chapter of Scottish history.
In 1745, the Jacobites, composed mainly of Scottish Highland clans, launched their second large-scale uprising against the government in London. After several campaigns, the Scottish forces initially advanced as far as Derby, only about 130-odd miles from London, and the capital was thrown into alarm. But in April of the following year, 1746, the Jacobites were decisively crushed at Culloden in Scotland, bringing to an end a Jacobite resistance movement that had lasted more than half a century.
In this campaign, the British army held captured Scots prisoner in Carlisle Castle, near the Scottish border. The English applied no fixed standard in dealing with these Scottish prisoners, choosing among them arbitrarily: some were executed, others released. It is said that one of the Scottish prisoners, sensing that he was about to be executed, wrote the song "Loch Lomond" and entrusted it to a fellow prisoner who was being released, asking him to carry it back to his beloved, who lived on the shore of Loch Lomond. This mournful, sorrowful ballad has drifted ever since over the hills and moors of Scotland, carried through the mist down to the present day.
Lyrics to 「Annie Laurie」:
"Maxwelton's braes are bonnie, where early falls the dew, and it was there that Annie Laurie gave me her promise true; she said she would never part from me, and I said I would never turn from her; for the sake of dear Annie Laurie, my heart will not change until death."
Lyrics to 「The Light in the Valley」:
"The light shines brightly in the little cottage, flickering in the window for me, far away on my travels. I know my mother is there, praying, praying for the child she longs to see. When the light shines in the valley, in my dreams I return home like a weary bird, and I see that light shining in the window, beckoning to me wherever I wander."
